why: Second recheck (0177) of the Reflect ban's slice 15 L4 in next/ and our tooling, on fabrikalfa/reflect-rest at 4dc340aab, for the e2e/node case of the fault named at 2f87d96ca. The topOf and directOnly change is right for what it covers: in a shared scratch clone, next/apps/fabrika/e2e/** in the JSON.parse warn block is now red (e2e/node advises and has no JSON.parse fire left) and next/packages/libfabrika/* is red (next/packages/libfabrika advises with no fire); unplanted L4 is green. Sent back to tests: the named fault, a warn-block glob that strips client/'s retry entries and demotes JSON.parse where it blocks with every law green, is still reached by a glob for a file kind, which this config writes in many blocks (for example next/packages/libfabrika/**/*Test.ts at .oxlintrc.json:767). L4 plants one file, zz-sample.ts, per folder, so a glob such as next/packages/libfabrika/src/**/*.test.ts never matches a sample. With that one glob added, L4 is green and the stale warn-line check finds the line held; a planted Effect.retry and JSON.parse in client/zz-plant.test.ts go from two errors to one JSON.parse warning, and a JSON.parse in access/zz-plant.test.ts from error to warning. On 6cbd89720's config with the same glob, both files keep their errors, since the client/ and access/ Reflect blocks came last. next/packages/libfabrika/src/*/*.test.ts is green too. So the stated limit, that only subfolders of a first-level folder listed whole with ** advise without a fire, is not true: client/ and access/ test files do.
note: Node 22 box, CI=1, nice -n 15, --maxWorkers=2, TYPESAFE_API_KEY unset. Read every changed line of oxlint-plugins/advice.test.ts (topOf's e2e root, directOnly, inside) and what calls them. Plants in a git clone --shared of 4dc340aab in the scratch directory, deleted after: next/apps/fabrika/e2e/** (red), next/packages/libfabrika/* (red), next/packages/libfabrika/src/*/*.test.ts (green), next/packages/libfabrika/src/**/*.test.ts (green); oxlint on planted client/ and access/ test files under the head config, the planted config and 6cbd89720's config with the same glob; advice.ts stale() on the planted config's warn lines with an oxlint run over libfabrika/src: no stale line. A fix must make the file-kind plant red: for example plant the sample at every tracked next/ code path, so each real file's own name and kind meet the globs, and read each file's ending, not only one zz-sample.ts per folder.
